capabilities: Chat with DeepSeek models and compress context near the token limit
Extract text from pasted or dragged PDFs with MinerU
Reference a local paper library with @ and import arXiv papers
Search and fetch public web pages using the DeepSeek API key
Collaboratively preview, edit, run, and export a local Jupyter notebook
disambiguation: Not just a DeepSeek chat window; it also parses PDFs with MinerU, manages an arXiv paper library, and edits Jupyter notebooks.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian Desktop 1.12.7 or later. Interface is English or Simplified Chinese. Search/Fetch and image recognition are charged through the DeepSeek API. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full data-flow details are in a separate PRIVACY.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and research workflows that need PDF text extraction, paper references, and runnable notebooks otherwise require separate tools.

relations.evidence: A desktop-only Obsidian plugin for DeepSeek conversations, PDF extraction with MinerU
DeepSeek Flash recognizes images; MinerU extracts PDF text.
Optionally collaborate on a local Jupyter notebook: preview cells, synchronize edits, run code

requires.name: Jupyter environment with jupyterlab, jupyter-collaboration, and ipykernel

summary: Desktop chat client for DeepSeek models with MinerU PDF extraction, arXiv paper references, web search, and Jupyter notebook collaboration.
